paraphrase: Oṃ, this all is the one syllable; Gaṇeśa, with and without qualities, is the supreme Brahman.

checks.note: The Māṇḍūkya-style opening 'omityekākṣaraṃ brahmedaṃ sarvam … sarvaṃ hy etad gaṇeśo'yam ātmā brahmeti' is the first section of the Gaṇeśottaratāpinī (e-text collection no. 110). The pūrva (no. 109) opens with verses to Brahmā and Gaṇeśa, and its 'nirguṇa/saguṇa' wording is in Upaniṣad Brahmayogin's maṅgala.
